# United Nations in India

> The official UN portal for operations and development initiatives across India, focusing on SDG implementation, sustainable agriculture, women empowerment, and multi-agency coordination.

This site serves as the central hub for UN agencies operating in India, coordinating development cooperation through the UNSDCF 2023-2027 framework. It features resources on sustainable development goals, impact stories from rural enterprises and food systems transformation, and official communications from the UN Resident Coordinator and country team.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- UN Country Team
- Development Cooperation
- Women Empowerment
- Food Systems
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Gender Equality
- UN Entities in India
- UNSDCF 2023-2027
- Agrifood Enterprise
- International Organizations
- Disability Rights
- New Delhi Operations
- India-UN Partnership
- Rural Development

## About the UN in India

- [United Nations in India](https://india.un.org/en): Homepage for UN operations in India covering SDGs and development initiatives
- [The UN in India](https://india.un.org/en/about/about-the-un): Overview of UN structure, Resident Coordinator, and development cooperation framework
- [UN Entities in Country](https://india.un.org/en/about/un-entities-in-country): Directory of UN agencies and specialized organizations operating in India
- [Our Work](https://india.un.org/en/171404-our-work): UNSDCF 2023-2027 partnership framework and UN-India strategic cooperation areas

## Sustainable Development & Action

- [Sustainable Development Goals](https://india.un.org/en/sdgs): Overview of SDGs and India's sustainable development priorities and coordination
- [Take Action](https://india.un.org/en/take-action): Campaigns and initiatives for SDG action on climate, rights, and inclusive development
- [Events](https://india.un.org/en/events): Searchable calendar of UN events, conferences, and observances in India

## Impact Stories & Resources

- [Our Stories](https://india.un.org/en/stories): Impact stories on women empowerment, food systems, and rural enterprises in India
- [Publications](https://india.un.org/en/resources/publications): Library of UN reports, SDG localization documents, and development cooperation resources
- [Video Stories](https://india.un.org/en/resources/video-stories): Video content on SDGs, environment, disability rights, vaccination, and refugees
- [Photo Stories](https://india.un.org/en/resources/photo-stories): Photo gallery featuring UN work on peacekeeping, SDGs, and women peacekeepers
- [Women Producers Strengthening India's Food Systems](https://india.un.org/en/311699-women-producers-strengthening-india%E2%80%99s-food-systems): Story on women-led farmer cooperatives and food systems transformation in Assam
- [Hansa Mehta's Life Story Continues to Inspire](https://india.un.org/en/311450-hansa-mehta%E2%80%99s-life-story-continues-inspire): Memorial article on pioneering Indian feminist and UN Human Rights advocate
- [UN Launches Global Road Safety Campaign in India](https://india.un.org/en/310584-un-launches-global-road-safety-campaign-india-calls-end-silent-epidemic-road-accidents): Coverage of UN road safety campaign launch in India with Secretary-General's Envoy

## Press & Communications

- [Press Releases](https://india.un.org/en/press-centre/press-releases): Archive of UN press releases on sustainable development and India initiatives
- [Speeches](https://india.un.org/en/press-centre/speeches): Searchable collection of speeches by UN officials on development and SDG topics
- [Media Contacts](https://india.un.org/en/press-centre/media-contacts): Contact directory for UN communications officers and media liaison representatives

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Us](https://india.un.org/en/contact-us): Contact information and office locations for UN agencies in New Delhi
